title: Part I Protheoria: Ulterius confirmatur — Augustana not Remonstrant; no Socinian commerce
pass_a_gloss: Ulterius confirmatur: from the foregoing it is plain — Augustana Confession Theologians have no necessity binding them with Remonstrants; Dordrecht had nothing to do with such brethren while they barred recocted Pelagianism with us. Also plain how ready fraternal conspiring of common Lutherans with Reformed would be, if from the pulpit, dropping quarrels and unjust delations to Princes/Magistrates, those stayed inside bounds. Add: Predestination dissent gave no cause to the Schism, nor was there contention with Luther on that (from what just said). Above all: Augsburg Society brethren have no Socinian commerce — unlike today's Remonstrants (history above, from p. 242). Likewise among so-called Lutherans: no palliation/excuse/diminution of Fundamental errors on Trinity, eternal Divinity & Generation of the Son, adoration of the Holy Spirit, Original Sin, Satisfaction of Christ, Justification by faith alone, etc.
pass_b_english: From which things it is plain how no necessity binds together the Theologians of the Augsburg Confession with the Remonstrants, and how the men of Dordrecht had nothing to do with brethren of that sort, while these latter barred recocted Pelagianism together with us. It is also plain how ready it would be for Lutherans in the common sense to conspire fraternally with the Reformed, if from the pulpit — dropping quarrels, and dropping also unjust delations before Princes and Magistrates — those men would keep within bounds. Add that dissent in the cause of Predestination gave no cause to the Schism, nor was there contention with Luther on that matter, from what has just been said. And above all, the Brethren of the Augsburg Society have no commerce with the Socinians, as today's Remonstrants do from the history above, from page 242.

So likewise among those called Lutherans there is no palliation of Fundamental errors, nor excuse, nor diminution, in the Heads concerning the Holy Trinity, the eternal Divinity and Generation of the Son, the adoration of the Holy Spirit, Original Sin, the Satisfaction of Christ, Justification by faith alone, and so on.
source_text: Ex quibus planum fit, quam nulla inter se necessitate colligentur Augustanae Confessionis Theologi cum Remonstrantibus, & quam nihil Dordracenis negotii fuerit cum hujusmodi Fratribus, dum recoctum hi Pelagianismum nobiscum arcerent. Planum etiam, quam proclive foret fraterne conspirare Lutheranos vulgo cum Reformatis, si pro suggestu, missis litigiis, missis etiam apud Principes & Magistratus iniquis delationibus, istos intra terminos consisterent. Accedit, dissensum in causa Praedestinationis nullam dedisse causam Schismati, nec ea de re contentionem cum Luthero fuisse, ex modo dictis. Cumprimis vero nullum cum Socinianis commercium est Fratribus Augustanae Societatis, uti est hodiernis Remonstrantibus ex superiore historia, a pag. 242. Sic nulla apud Lutheranos, qui dicuntur, Fundamentalium palliatio errorum, vel excusatio, aut imminutio, in Capitibus de S. Trinitate, aeterna Divinitate & Generatione Filii, adoratione Spiritus S. Peccato Originis, Satisfactione Christi, Justificatione per fidem solam, &c.
